distribution_boundary.description: Owner decisions of 19 November 2026. Distributed: the source code in the public OpenMettle repositories, including the source of the OpenMettle/sglang curated fork, and the Helm chart in openmettle-deploy. Not distributed yet: built container images (including the core api, worker and migrate images and any image built from the SGLang fork), re-hosted third-party images, other curated forks (the OpenMettle/open-webui fork is reference material only) and model weights. Third-party images are referenced only at their publishers' locations. Long-term direction: distribute everything needed to run OpenMettle, eventually as an Arch Linux distribution with everything preinstalled except components whose licences do not allow redistribution. Each widening of the boundary is a separate owner decision; publishing the core images (V1-36) is the likely next one.
